) said on Monday that it will acquire SmartCore Holdings in an all-stock deal worth $100M.
AIOS Tech will purchase the shares from Better Way Holdings, Novo Spring Management and Cloud Spring, which collectively hold all the issued and outstanding shares of SmartCore.
Under the deal, AIOS Tech will issue to the sellers an aggregate of 33,333,334 Class A common shares, with a par value of $0.0001 per share.
The parties valued the consideration shares at $3.00 per share for purposes of the transaction.

Based on 3,249,337 Class A common shares and 5,000,000 Class B common shares outstanding immediately before the closing, and assuming no other share issuances before the closing, the sellers are expected to hold nearly 80.16% of the AIOS Tech's total issued and outstanding shares and about 6.21% of its total voting power immediately after the issuance of the consideration shares.
The transaction is expected to close on or before November 30, 2026.

title: AIOS Tech to acquire SmartCore Holdings in all-stock deal
